An organization chart showing the structure of a typical Nigerian military government. At the top is a box. Below it, a line connects to the "Supreme Legislative Body (SMC / AFRC / PRC)". A branch leads to the "Federal Executive Council (FEC)". Below the central structure, lines lead to multiple boxes which further branch into "State Executive Councils". A separate floating box on the side represents the "Judiciary", with a dotted line indicating its limited independence.
